purpose: Define how parent and child carriers are compared without using chi, kinetic outcomes, favorable frequencies, or target-system results to choose the correspondence.

does_not_retroactively_promote: historical Stability Arc results outside their registered domain

shared_degree_of_freedom_rule.primary: Establish the shared parent degrees of freedom from atom/coordinate identity, geometry mapping, boundary convention, and mass convention before modal comparison.
forbidden: choosing shared degrees of freedom because they maximize modal overlap
changing atom or coordinate mapping after inspecting chi or target kinetics
dropping low-overlap coordinates solely to improve inheritance evidence

mass_normalization_rule.individual_modes: Normalize parent and child carriers in the same positive mass metric on the shared physical degrees of freedom before overlap is computed.
mass_normalization_rule.overlap_definition: O_ij = |v_i(parent)^T M P_parent v_j(child)|^2 after compatible mass normalization, with conjugate transpose used for complex carriers.

individual_mode_rule.use_when: Modes are sufficiently isolated and numerically identifiable for an individual carrier comparison.
individual_mode_rule.assignment: Report the complete overlap matrix and a permutation-invariant maximum-total-overlap assignment as a diagnostic. The assignment does not by itself establish inheritance.
mandatory_companions: full overlap row and column context

subspace_rule.use_when: Exact or practical degeneracy, spectral crowding, mode splitting, mode merging, or unstable basis orientation makes individual eigenvectors non-identifiable.
subspace_rule.comparison: Compare the relevant parent and child subspaces using projector overlap and singular values/principal-angle cosines rather than forcing one-to-one vector identity.
subspace_rule.basis_rotation_within_same_subspace: must not be classified as inheritance loss solely because individual eigenvectors rotate
subspace_rule.split_or_merge: retain the resolved overlap weights and subspace relation; do not force a single descendant label

scalar_rule.ordering: Carrier correspondence is established without using scalar closeness to chi=1 or any other favored scalar value. Scalar inheritance is evaluated only after the carrier map is frozen.
required_for_scalar_inheritance: pre-specified parent-to-child scalar transformation or prediction
scalar_rule.if_scalar_not_licensed: retain modal/conglomeration result and return scalar NOT_APPLICABLE or NONIDENTIFIABLE

objects: parent-to-child coupling matrix or equivalent interaction operator
frequency-dependent substrate self-energy/embedding contribution where defined
memory kernel or spectral-density object where independently derived
network or sequence of modal/subspace relations across assembly or reaction-path states

nulls.same_spectrum_modal_scramble: Preserve parent eigenvalues while randomizing modal geometry to test whether scalar spectral resemblance alone explains the observed correspondence.
nulls.coupling_rewire: Preserve the parent operator while changing carrier-to-child coupling assignment to test conglomeration specificity.
nulls.zero_coupling: Set the parent-child coupling to zero where the model permits it to verify that the analysis does not manufacture influence.
nulls.generic_or_alternative_parent: When a physically defensible alternative exists, compare predictive performance without tuning the alternative after target reveal.

statistical_reporting.current_rule: Report continuous observed scores and their position relative to preregistered synthetic/null distributions. No physical inheritance pass threshold is frozen in v0.1.
statistical_reporting.reason: A numerical cutoff chosen before physical calibration would be arbitrary; a cutoff chosen after target reveal would be circular.
statistical_reporting.future_threshold_rule: Any later physical promotion threshold must be frozen before the corresponding real-system target result is inspected and must document how it was calibrated.

promotion_rule.influence: nonzero causal/interventional response without complete prospective correspondence
promotion_rule.conditional_inheritance: parent characterization, carrier correspondence, frozen mapping, and successful prospective prediction without complete intervention/specificity closure
promotion_rule.substrate_inheritance: all influence, carrier, prospective prediction, intervention, and specificity requirements pass under the active contract

forbidden_target_leakage: using chi proximity to choose a mode
using reaction rate or barrier agreement to choose a modal mapping
using a known child frequency to redefine the parent carrier
changing a correspondence rule after seeing whether it supports inheritance
